grants.description: Verify your identity using passport or national identity card details
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and right to work in the UK before issuing a National Insurance number

grants.description: Upload photos of yourself holding your passport and other identity documents
grants.purpose: To verify your identity documents are genuine and match your appearance

grants.description: Share your right to work status and immigration documents if applicable
grants.purpose: To confirm you have the right to work in the UK, which is required to receive a National Insurance number

grants.description: Provide your current UK address for DWP records and correspondence
grants.purpose: To confirm you live in the UK and to send your National Insurance number notification letter

grants.description: Share details about your current or prospective employment status
grants.purpose: To confirm you meet the requirement of working, looking for work, or having a job offer

grants.description: Check DWP records to see if you already have a National Insurance number
grants.purpose: To prevent duplicate applications and inform you if you already have a National Insurance number

revocation.mechanism: Contact DWP National Insurance number application helpline on 0800 141 2079 or email confirmation link
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before registration is complete. You will need to reapply if you still need a National Insurance number.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot attend in-person appointments on your behalf. Agent cannot provide original identity documents. Agent cannot confirm your right to work without you providing documentary evidence. If manual verification is required, you will be contacted directly by DWP.
